title: Unfinished Tales of Númenor and Middle-earth
author: J.R.R. Tolkien
description: A collection of stories and essays by J.R.R. Tolkien that were never completed during his lifetime, but were edited by his son Christopher Tolkien and published in 1980. Many of the tales within are retold in The Silmarillion, albeit in modified forms.

title: The Future of Socialism
author: Anthony Crosland
description: A radical reworking of the role of the post-war Labour Party. This book sets out the philosophy for the New Labour project and contains the key for reviving the fortunes of the Party of the future.

title: The Cosmic Connection
author: Carl Sagan
description: An extraterrestrial perspective on life, the universe, and everything. Originally published in 1973, this book explores the possibility of life on other planets, the origin of life, and our place in the cosmos through Sagan's remarkable ability to make scientific ideas both comprehensible and exciting.

title: On Anarchism
author: Noam Chomsky
description: The definitive primer on anarchist thought and practice. Known for his brilliant evisceration of American foreign policy, state capitalism, and the mainstream media, Chomsky provides a short, accessible introduction to his distinctively optimistic brand of anarchism.

title: The Precipice
author: Toby Ord
description: Existential Risk and the Future of Humanity. Drawing on over a decade of research, The Precipice explores the cutting-edge science behind the risks we face and points the way forward to actions and strategies that can safeguard humanity.
